content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-what-actually-2|COREMERCH guide to digital]] creators in regions facing restrictive platforms like Stripe and PayPal need a reliable infrastructure to sell their products. COREMERCH provides a solution through a sovereign digital commerce stack, allowing you to deploy a fully operational online store in under six hours. This guide focuses on leveraging Supabase as your order database for a digital store, enabling seamless [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-3|Crypto Payment]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-one-afternoon-fast|payment]]s without reliance on traditional payment systems.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Stack 01 — the Sovereign Starter Stack — uses GitHub Pages for storefront hosting, Google Apps Script as the backend Web App, Google Sheets as the order database, Google Drive for product file storage, and Gmail for delivery email. The entire stack costs nothing per month. Google Apps Script runs in response to webhook events from NOWPayments, validates the payment, logs the order to Google Sheets, generates a receipt, and sends a Gmail delivery email with a Google Drive shared link. The daily limits on the free tier are adequate for most creators at the early and growth stages.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before embarking on your deployment, gather the necessary tools: a GitHub account for hosting your site, access to Google Apps Script for backend functionality, and a NOWPayments account for processing crypto payments. Additionally, set up a Supabase account to manage your order database. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides a comprehensive guide to deploying Stack 01 in 4-6 hours.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The NOWPayments configuration sequence is the same regardless of which stack you are deploying. Create a NOWPayments account — no KYC required, no document upload, no bank account needed. Navigate to the wallet settings and add the wallet addresses for each cryptocurrency you want to accept. USDT on Tron and Bitcoin are the practical starting point for most creators in restricted markets. Generate an API key from the NOWPayments dashboard. Set the webhook endpoint URL in the NOWPayments IPN settings pointing to your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App. Set the webhook secret key — a string you generate that both NOWPayments and your backend know.
Own your infrastructure fully with no dependencies.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Deploy your GitHub Pages site and connect it to your Google Apps Script backend. Test the payment flow with a small transaction to ensure everything functions as expected. Once verified, promote your digital store, directing traffic to your new site. Monitor transactions through Supabase to track orders and customer interactions effectively.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your initial deployment, consider scaling by adding more products and optimizing your store. Leverage the features of Supabase for enhanced order management and customer insights. As your sales grow, explore additional integrations with marketing tools to boost visibility. If you require more complex functionalities, consider transitioning to the Edge Commerce Stack, which offers advanced features and configurations for rapid deployment.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Automate crypto payments with minimal fees.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a free digital store by using GitHub Pages for hosting and integrating Google Apps Script for backend operations. NOWPayments will handle crypto payments, allowing you to sell your products without traditional payment barriers.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, deployed in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 offers Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for a more robust solution, deployed in 48 hours with advanced configurations.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent options for hosting your digital product store. They provide free hosting solutions while allowing you to integrate necessary backend functionalities for order processing.
How does NOWPayments work with my digital store?

NOWPayments integrates seamlessly with your store to automate crypto payment processing. It requires no KYC, offers low fees, and sends instant notifications upon payment confirmation, ensuring a smooth transaction experience for your customers.
What products can I sell using this infrastructure?

You can sell various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, and software. This infrastructure allows you to reach global customers without being restricted by traditional payment platforms.
